messages:
sam: noticed a sudden uptick in 5xx for eu-west embeddings after the overnight quant tweak. Product reported failing batch jobs. Can we fast-track a hotfix? @ivy @tj
ops-bot: alert: embeddings-service (eu-west1) 5xx rate 3.9% over 5m, affected route=/v1/embeddings, origin=canary:false
ivy: I have a small fix branch hotfix/kv-guard-eu that adds a null-check and safer deserialiser fallback. Staged smoke passed.
tj: oncall here. I can approve expedited deploy if we keep canary small and define rollback rules. Propose rollback if 5xx >1% for 5m or error rate >2x baseline.
sam: approved. Also require temporary route pin to eu-west1=hotfix until we verify. Who will run it?
ivy: I'll run it. Plan: `/deploy hotfix hotfix/kv-guard-eu --env=eu-west1 --canary=5% --monitor=6m --pin-route=eu-west1=hotfix/kv-guard-eu`
deploy-bot: command received: /deploy hotfix hotfix/kv-guard-eu --env=eu-west1 --canary=5% --monitor=6m --pin-route=eu-west1=hotfix/kv-guard-eu
deploy-bot: starting 5% canary in eu-west1, monitor window 6m. Notifying ops and release channels.
ops-bot: sampling logs and traces; will report mid-window.
(3m later)
ops-bot: canary update: 5xx on canary hosts 0.25% (baseline 0.22%). Trace samples show fallback path exercised, no new timeouts.
tj: expand to 30% and monitor another 6m.
ivy: `/deploy scale hotfix hotfix/kv-guard-eu --to=30% --monitor=6m`
deploy-bot: scaling canary to 30% in eu-west1.
ops-bot: 2m into window: 5xx 0.28%, p95 latency stable. CPU/memory normal.
sam: if final window clean, promote and keep temporary route pin for 1 hour before unpinning.
(8m later)
deploy-bot: canary windows passed. promoting to 100% in eu-west1
deploy-bot: promotion complete. route pin applied: eu-west1 -> hotfix/kv-guard-eu (temporary)
ops-bot: post-promote checks (5m): 5xx down to 0.09%, p95 latency back to baseline. No regressions.
tj: marking expedited approval closed. Ivy — please post final release note with commit hash and the rollback command to runbook.
ivy: release note: "hotfix/kv-guard-eu (commit f9c8a7b) 8; added KV chunk null-check + safe deserialiser fallback. Rollforward OK. Revert: /deploy rollback f9c8a7b --env=eu-west1"
support: preparing a short customer blurb, will hold until metrics stable for 30m.
sam: thanks everyone. Leaving the temporary pin for one hour per plan, then unpin if stable.
